chhattisgarhi.name: Chhattisgarhi Buffalo
chhattisgarhi.native_region: Central India (Raipur, Bilaspur, Durg, Rajnandgaon, Bastar)
chhattisgarhi.description: Chhattisgarhi buffalo is an indigenous hardy river-swamp buffalo breed of central India. Known for its remarkable heat resilience, ability to thrive on coarse low-quality crop residues, disease resistance, and reliable milk with rich fat content under harsh agro-climatic conditions.

physical_traits.coat_color: Predominantly black or dark brown; occasional white patches on forehead or switch of tail
physical_traits.horns: Medium to large horns curving outwards, backwards, and upwards towards neck
physical_traits.body_structure: Medium compact frame, strong legs, wide chest, deep barrel, hard hooves adapted for muddy paddy fields
physical_traits.climate_resilience: Superb tolerance to tropical heat, humidity, and monsoon mud; highly resistant to tick infestations

milk_production.daily_yield_liters: 7 - 14 liters/day (Under improved feeding up to 16 L/day)

milk_quality.fat_globule_size: Large dense fat globules, pure white color (no beta-carotene in buffalo milk)
milk_quality.suitability: World-class for traditional ghee, rich paneer, khoa, rabri, kulfi, and curd (dahi)
milk_quality.somatic_cell_count: Extremely low; high natural lysozyme and lactoferrin content
milk_quality.nutritional_highlights: High calcium, natural probiotics support, dense caloric value

possible_diseases.name: Hemorrhagic Septicemia (HS / Galghontu)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Sudden high fever (106°F), severe swelling in throat and neck, snoring breath, tongue protrusion, death within 24-36 hrs
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Monsoon moisture, high humidity, stress in riverine/marsh areas

possible_diseases.name: Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD / Khurpaka-Munhpaka)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Drooling ropy saliva, painful foot sores, reluctance to walk in mud, lactation drop
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Seasonal viral epidemics, lack of vaccination

possible_diseases.name: Trypanosomiasis (Surra)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Intermittent fever, nervous signs (circling, head pressing), rapid emaciation, blindness
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Tabanid fly bites during rainy and post-rainy seasons

possible_diseases.name: Subclinical Mastitis
possible_diseases.symptoms: Hardness in udder quarter, clot formation in milk, reduced output
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Improper hand milking (knuckling), dirty wallowing ponds

possible_diseases.name: Black Quarter (BQ / Langda Bukhar)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Crepitating (crackling) swelling over heavy muscle (thigh/shoulder), severe lameness, fever
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Soil-borne Clostridium chauvoei spores entering through minor cuts

cure_and_treatment.emergency_first_aid: For HS (Galghontu): Immediate emergency veterinary intervention with IV Sulfadimidine (33.3% at 100-150ml) + Oxytetracycline + Dexamethasone to relieve respiratory choking.
veterinary_medicines: Quinapyramine Sulfate and Chloride (3.3 mg/kg SC) / Diminazene for Surra
Sulfadimidine sodium / Ceftriaxone for acute bacterial septicemia
Intramammary infusions for mastitis with herbal udder sprays
Meloxicam + Paracetamol boluses for fever and joint inflammation
cure_and_treatment.supportive_care: Liver tonic (Liv-52 vet), electrolyte drenches, regular seasonal deworming with Albendazole / Ivermectin.
cure_and_treatment.ethnoveterinary_remedies: For mouth sores (FMD): Clean mouth with alum water (10g/L), apply paste of honey + turmeric powder (50g) + coconut oil. For foot wounds: Apply camphor in neem oil.

vaccination_schedule.vaccine: Hemorrhagic Septicemia (HS) Alum Precipitated / Oil Adjuvant
vaccination_schedule.importance: Top-priority mandatory vaccine for all buffaloes in central India
Essential protection for young and adult stock

market_price.economic_roi: Extremely cost-effective for smallholder farmers due to negligible maintenance costs, high ghee recovery (8%+ fat), and strong disease resilience.

daily_feed_requirements.green_fodder_kg: 20 - 30 kg/day (Paddy straw green forage, Para grass, Hybrid Napier, Maize)
daily_feed_requirements.concentrate_feed_kg: 1 kg per 2.0 liters of buffalo milk yield + 1.5 kg maintenance (Mustard/Linseed cake, rice bran, chana chuni)

maintenance_and_housing.housing_and_shed_design: Semi-pucca open shed with thatched or tile roof for natural insulation. Floor space: 45 sq.ft covered, 90 sq.ft open area.
maintenance_and_housing.summer_heat_management: Buffaloes have fewer sweat glands; daily water wallowing in clean pond for 1-2 hours or splashing with cold water 2-3 times daily during summer.
maintenance_and_housing.milking_hygiene_protocol: Full hand milking method (avoid thumb bending), wash udder with potassium permanganate (1:1000) solution, keep calf alongside for letdown if required.

gir.name: Gir Cattle
gir.native_region: Western & Central India (Gujarat, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, MP)
gir.description: Gir is one of the most celebrated indigenous zebu dairy breeds of India, globally renowned for its high milk yield, distinct domed forehead (convex head), long pendulous ears, lyre-shaped horns curving backward, calm temperament, and 100% pure A2 beta-casein milk.

physical_traits.coat_color: Spotted red and white to solid reddish-brown or speckled dark chocolate
physical_traits.horns: Curved backwards and upwards resembling lyres with blunt dark tips
physical_traits.body_structure: Prominent convex forehead acting as a natural thermal shield, long leaf-like folded pendulous ears, prominent hump, loose pendulous dewlap, well-attached capacious udder
physical_traits.temperament: Extremely gentle, affectionate, intelligent, and docile
physical_traits.climate_resilience: Superb heat, humidity, and tropical tick tolerance; thrives in ambient temperatures exceeding 45°C

milk_quality.beta_casein_type: 100% Pure A2 beta-casein (A2A2 genotype naturally fixed)
milk_quality.fat_globule_size: Medium golden fat globules rich in natural beta-carotene (giving Gir Ghee its characteristic golden hue)
milk_quality.suitability: Premium A2 Vedic Bilona Ghee, gold-grade butter, drinking milk, curd, paneer, and ayurvedic formulations
milk_quality.somatic_cell_count: Extremely low due to high natural lysozyme and immune resilience
milk_quality.nutritional_highlights: Rich in CLA (Conjugated Linoleic Acid), Omega-3 fatty acids, cerebrosides, and strontium

possible_diseases.name: Subclinical & Clinical Mastitis
possible_diseases.symptoms: Quarter swelling, flaky milk, tenderness during milking
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Improper hand milking (thumb folding), unhygienic shed floors

possible_diseases.name: Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Oral vesicles, foot sores, excess drooling saliva, fever, sudden lactation drop

possible_diseases.name: Hemorrhagic Septicemia (HS)
possible_diseases.symptoms: High fever (105-107°F), throat edema, difficult breathing with snoring sound

possible_diseases.name: Bloat / Tympanites
possible_diseases.symptoms: Distended left flank, grunting, kicking at belly, labored breathing
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Excess consumption of lush young legumes or wet fermentable forage

possible_diseases.name: Tick Infestation & Theileriosis
possible_diseases.symptoms: Mild anemia, lymph node swelling (Gir has high natural tick resistance compared to exotic breeds)
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Heavy vector presence in untrimmed pastures

cure_and_treatment.emergency_first_aid: For bloat: Administer 50-100ml vegetable/mustard oil with 15ml turpentine oil orally, walk the animal slowly. For acute mastitis: Strip affected quarter and apply ice-cold water compresses.
veterinary_medicines: Intramammary Ceftiofur / Cloxacillin for mastitis
Sulfadimidine sodium (33.3% IV) / Ceftriaxone for acute bacterial septicemia
Meloxicam (0.5 mg/kg) + Paracetamol for pain and inflammation
Broad-spectrum dewormers (Fenbendazole 10 mg/kg / Ivermectin)
cure_and_treatment.supportive_care: Chelated mineral mixture (Minfa Gold / Agrimin), liver tonic (BroTone), vitamin H (Biotin) for udder health.
cure_and_treatment.ethnoveterinary_remedies: For mastitis: Blend 250g Aloe vera + 50g turmeric powder + 15g chunam (slaked lime) into paste and apply externally on udder 3 times daily. For general immunity: Boil giloy (Tinospora cordifolia) + ashwagandha + turmeric in water.

vaccination_schedule.importance: Prevents fatal Pasteurellosis before rainy season
Protects young heifers and bulls against Clostridial myositis

vaccination_schedule.timing: Once in lifetime for female calves (4 - 8 months)
vaccination_schedule.importance: Prevents brucella abortion and zoonotic transmission

vaccination_schedule.vaccine: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD / Goat Pox heterologous)
vaccination_schedule.importance: Prevents nodular cutaneous lesions and production loss

market_price.economic_roi: Extremely high profit margins due to immense consumer premium for pure A2 Gir milk (₹80-₹120/L) and Vedic Bilona Ghee (selling at ₹2,000 - ₹3,500/kg).

daily_feed_requirements.green_fodder_kg: 25 - 35 kg/day (Jowar, Maize, Hybrid Napier, Lucerne, Cowpea)
daily_feed_requirements.dry_fodder_kg: 5 - 7 kg/day (Groundnut haulms, Wheat straw, Jowar kadbi)
daily_feed_requirements.concentrate_feed_kg: 1 kg per 2.5 liters milk yield + 1.5 kg maintenance (Mustard/Cottonseed cake, crushed maize, wheat bran)

maintenance_and_housing.housing_and_shed_design: Open loose housing system with thatched/tiled shaded roof (10-12 ft height). Floor space: 40-50 sq.ft covered, 80-100 sq.ft open loafing area.
maintenance_and_housing.summer_heat_management: Naturally extremely heat tolerant; provide tree shade, adequate drinking water, and ceiling fans when temperature exceeds 42°C.
maintenance_and_housing.milking_hygiene_protocol: Full hand milking method, udder washing with lukewarm potassium permanganate (1:1000) solution, post-milking teat dip.

jaffarabadi.name: Jaffarabadi Buffalo
jaffarabadi.native_region: Western India (Junagadh, Amreli, Bhavnagar, Porbandar, Jamnagar in Gujarat)
jaffarabadi.description: Jaffarabadi is the heaviest and most powerful river buffalo breed in the world. Renowned for its massive head with prominent drooping horn crest, immense milk capacity with high butterfat content (>8%), and sheer strength. Known locally as the 'Pride of Gir'.

physical_traits.coat_color: Deep solid black; occasional small white markings on forehead (known as 'Tika')
physical_traits.horns: Heavy, broad, flat horns drooping downwards along the neck and curling upwards at tips like a loose knot

body_weight.female_adult_kg: 600 - 800 kg (Can exceed 850 kg in elite show animals)

physical_traits.body_structure: Massive, deep, and heavy bone structure, wide prominent forehead, dewlap well developed, large pendulous udder
physical_traits.temperament: Calm and docile with familiar handlers, fiercely protective of calves
physical_traits.climate_resilience: Very hardy in semi-arid and coastal tropical environments; loves water wallowing

milk_quality.fat_globule_size: Large dense fat globules producing the highest recovery of traditional Gir Ghee
milk_quality.suitability: Benchmark for premium Desi Ghee, creamy Mawa/Khoya, thick buffalo curd, Paneer, and Pedas
milk_quality.nutritional_highlights: Exceptional energy density, rich in fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E and bioactive peptides

possible_diseases.name: Uterine & Vaginal Prolapse (Peecha Nikalna)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Eversion of vaginal wall or uterus post/pre-calving, straining, recumbency
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Heavy pelvic weight, hormonal relaxation, calcium-phosphorus imbalance, steep shed floor slope

possible_diseases.name: Hemorrhagic Septicemia (HS)
possible_diseases.symptoms: High fever, throat edema, severe respiratory stertor, rapid death
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Rainy season, waterlogged pasture, contact with carrier animals

possible_diseases.name: Mastitis (Thela Disease)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Swollen hard udder, blood or pus in milk, severe pain during milking
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Large pendulous udder touching ground, dirty wallowing ponds

possible_diseases.name: Trypanosomiasis (Surra)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Intermittent fever, circling gait, progressive anemia, corneal opacity
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Biting Tabanus flies near coastal water bodies

possible_diseases.name: Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Vesicles in mouth, between hooves, high fever, extreme salivation

cure_and_treatment.emergency_first_aid: For Prolapse: Wash exposed organ immediately with ice-cold normal saline / potassium permanganate solution (1:1000), gently push back in epidural anesthesia and apply Buhner's suture or rope truss. For HS: Immediate IV Sulfadimidine (33.3%) + Ceftriaxone.
veterinary_medicines: Quinapyramine Sulfate/Chloride for Surra
Intramammary antibiotics (Amoxicillin-Sulbactam) + Serratiopeptidase for acute udder swelling
Oral calcium-phosphorus supplements (Cal-Up, Ostovet Forte) + Vitamin E & Biotin
Broad spectrum dewormer (Closantel / Fenbendazole)
cure_and_treatment.supportive_care: Provide mineral boluses with zinc, cobalt, copper; feed bypass fat (200g/day) during peak lactation.
cure_and_treatment.ethnoveterinary_remedies: For prolapse prevention: Feed 100g fenugreek powder (methi) + 50g cumin (jeera) + 200g ghee in jaggery daily during last trimester.

market_price.economic_roi: Very high economic returns due to immense ghee output (1.5-2x price multiplier in Indian market for pure buffalo ghee).

daily_feed_requirements.dry_fodder_kg: 8 - 10 kg/day (Groundnut haulms, Wheat straw, Bajra stover)
daily_feed_requirements.concentrate_feed_kg: 1 kg per 2.0 liters milk + 2.5 kg maintenance (Cottonseed cake, Mustard cake, crushed maize, wheat bran)

maintenance_and_housing.housing_and_shed_design: Spacious shed with high roof (14-16 ft) for ventilation. Covered area 60-70 sq.ft per adult animal. Level floor with grooved brick texture to prevent slipping and prolapse.
maintenance_and_housing.summer_heat_management: Dedicated clean wallowing pool (water depth 3-4 ft) or continuous shower system for 2 hours during peak afternoon.
maintenance_and_housing.milking_hygiene_protocol: Full hand milking method (stripping only for final drops), warm water udder cleaning, fly repellents around shed.

jersey_cattle.name: Jersey Cattle
jersey_cattle.origin: Island of Jersey, British Channel Islands
jersey_cattle.native_region: Worldwide (Highly popular in India, USA, New Zealand, UK, Denmark)
jersey_cattle.description: Jersey cattle are renowned for their compact, graceful size, distinctive fawn coat, large expressive eyes, and milk of unrivaled nutritional density with the highest butterfat and protein percentages among major dairy breeds. They are exceptionally heat tolerant and feed efficient.

physical_traits.coat_color: Light fawn to mulberry or dark chestnut brown, often with dark face shading and white muzzle ring
physical_traits.horns: Short, curved upward with dark tips (often disbudded)
physical_traits.body_structure: Compact, refined dairy conformation, fine bone structure, well-attached udder, dished facial profile
physical_traits.temperament: Very gentle, curious, and friendly (Bulls can be territorial)
physical_traits.climate_resilience: Outstanding heat tolerance compared to other European breeds; performs excellently in tropical and subtropical Indian climates

milk_quality.beta_casein_type: Predominantly A2 beta-casein (over 70-80% of Jersey population carries A2A2 genes)
milk_quality.fat_globule_size: Large butterfat globules with rich golden-yellow tint due to high beta-carotene
milk_quality.suitability: World's best milk for artisan butter, premium ghee, ice cream, rich curds, and specialty cheeses
milk_quality.nutritional_highlights: 20% more calcium and 18% more protein per glass compared to average commercial milk

possible_diseases.name: Milk Fever (Severe Hypocalcemia)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Sudden onset paralysis within 24-48 hrs of calving, head turned into flank, hypothermia, bloat
possible_diseases.risk_factors: High Jersey genetic predisposition due to extreme calcium-rich colostrum production

possible_diseases.name: Subclinical Mastitis
possible_diseases.symptoms: High electrical conductivity in milk, slight flake formation, somatic cell elevation
possible_diseases.risk_factors: High vacuum in milking machines, cracked teats

possible_diseases.name: Theileriosis & Tick-Borne Anemia
possible_diseases.symptoms: High fever, lymph node enlargement, pale gums, anorexia

possible_diseases.name: Foot Rot & Interdigital Dermatitis
possible_diseases.symptoms: Lameness, swelling between claws, reluctance to walk to feed bunk

possible_diseases.name: FMD (Foot and Mouth Disease)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Mouth blisters, foot lesions, high fever, abrupt cessation of lactation
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Direct viral contact with infected livestock

cure_and_treatment.emergency_first_aid: For Milk Fever: Administer 450ml IV Calcium Borogluconate slowly over 15 minutes, followed by 450ml SC. For acute mastitis: Intramammary antibiotic infusion + anti-inflammatory injection.
veterinary_medicines: Oral Calcium gels (Calfostonic / Cal-D-Gel) given 24h before calving and immediately post-calving to prevent downer state
Buparvaquone (2.5 mg/kg IM) for Theileriosis
Meloxicam / Tolfenamic acid for pain and anti-inflammatory relief
Ceftiofur / Amoxicillin for systemic bacterial infections
cure_and_treatment.supportive_care: Provide Vitamin D3 injections prior to calving to enhance intestinal calcium absorption; feed anionic salts in dry period.
cure_and_treatment.ethnoveterinary_remedies: For udder care: Mix coconut oil (100ml) with camphor (10g) and apply gently on swollen teats after milking.

vaccination_schedule.importance: Vital for crossbred/purebred Jersey in India

market_price.economic_roi: Exceptional profitability for dairy farmers selling milk based on Fat & SNF pricing models; lower feed consumption per liter than HF.

daily_feed_requirements.concentrate_feed_kg: 1 kg per 2.0 liters milk + 1.5 kg maintenance feed

maintenance_and_housing.housing_and_shed_design: Compact shed space (35-45 sq.ft covered area). Good cross-ventilation, brick-on-edge or grooved concrete floor, dry straw or sand bedding.
maintenance_and_housing.summer_heat_management: Natural shade trees or mesh netting around shed. Jerseys handle heat well but benefit from roof sprinklers when temperature exceeds 36°C.
maintenance_and_housing.milking_hygiene_protocol: Gentle hand or machine milking at 38-40 kPa vacuum. Iodine barrier teat dip after each milking session.

kankrej.name: Kankrej Cattle
kankrej.description: Kankrej (also known as Vadhiyar) is one of the heaviest and most magnificent indigenous Indian cattle breeds. Renowned for its massive lyre-shaped horns, characteristic majestic Sawai Chal (1 1/4 pace gait), silver-grey coat with dark shading in bulls, high disease resistance, and rich A2 dairy yield.

physical_traits.coat_color: Silver-grey to iron-grey; adult males have dark shoulders and forequarters
physical_traits.horns: Massive lyre-shaped horns curving outward, upward, and slightly inward with sharp tips
physical_traits.body_structure: Strong, broad, powerful frame with deep chest, large hump, pendulous dewlap, hard durable hooves
physical_traits.temperament: Active, spirited, yet loyal and manageable
physical_traits.climate_resilience: Exceptional heat tolerance, drought resistance, and natural immunity to tick-borne diseases

milk_quality.suitability: Excellent for A2 drinking milk, bilona ghee, butter, and traditional sweets
milk_quality.somatic_cell_count: Very low natural somatic cell count
milk_quality.nutritional_highlights: Rich in immunoglobulins, bioavailable calcium, and CLA

possible_diseases.name: Mastitis
possible_diseases.symptoms: Quarter swelling, tenderness, clot formation in milk

possible_diseases.name: Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Salivation, oral blisters, foot lesions, lameness

possible_diseases.name: Hemorrhagic Septicemia (HS)
possible_diseases.symptoms: High fever, throat swelling, snoring respiration

possible_diseases.name: Black Quarter (BQ)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Crepitating muscle swelling, lameness, high fever

cure_and_treatment.emergency_first_aid: For HS: Emergency Sulfadimidine (33.3% IV) + Flunixin Meglumine. For foot lesions: Wash with 1% potassium permanganate and apply camphor in neem oil.
veterinary_medicines: Intramammary antibiotics (Amoxicillin-Sulbactam) for mastitis
Oxytetracycline / Enrofloxacin for bacterial infections
Meloxicam + Paracetamol for pain relief
Fenbendazole / Closantel for regular deworming
cure_and_treatment.supportive_care: Chelated mineral mixture, liver extract with B-complex, electrolyte drench during heat waves.
cure_and_treatment.ethnoveterinary_remedies: For wound healing: Neem leaves + turmeric + castor oil boiled paste applied externally.

market_price.economic_roi: High dual-purpose value; bulls are premier draught animals while cows produce premium A2 milk with low input costs.

daily_feed_requirements.dry_fodder_kg: 6 - 8 kg/day (Wheat straw, Bajra stover, Groundnut haulms)
daily_feed_requirements.concentrate_feed_kg: 1 kg per 2.5 L milk + 2 kg maintenance (Cottonseed cake, crushed barley/maize)

maintenance_and_housing.housing_and_shed_design: Open paddock system with durable fencing and semi-covered stall (50 sq.ft covered, 100 sq.ft open). Grooved brick/concrete flooring.
maintenance_and_housing.summer_heat_management: High natural heat tolerance; provide adequate drinking water troughs and tree canopy.
maintenance_and_housing.milking_hygiene_protocol: Full hand milking, clean teat washing, strip cup testing.

marathwada.name: Marathwada Buffalo
marathwada.native_region: Central-Western India (Beed, Parbhani, Nanded, Latur, Jalna, Osmanabad in Maharashtra)
marathwada.description: Marathwada buffalo is a hardy, medium-sized indigenous breed adapted to the drought-prone semi-arid Deccan plateau. Known for its distinct long flat sword-shaped horns reaching back to the shoulders, exceptional heat tolerance, low water requirement, and steady milk production on dry fodder.

physical_traits.coat_color: Predominantly dark brown to black; coat is glossy and sparse-haired
physical_traits.horns: Long, flat, sword-shaped horns extending backwards along the sides of the neck, reaching up to the shoulder blades
physical_traits.body_structure: Medium, light, and compact frame, long narrow head, light agile legs with hard compact hooves
physical_traits.temperament: Active, docile, very intelligent and adaptable
physical_traits.climate_resilience: Superb drought resistance; can endure water scarcity and high ambient temperatures (>44°C) without severe drop in production

milk_quality.suitability: Ideal for traditional Maharashtrian Ghee, Shrikhand, Basundi, Gulab Jamun mawa, and rich tea milk
milk_quality.somatic_cell_count: Very low; excellent natural disease resistance
milk_quality.nutritional_highlights: Rich in minerals, easily digestible A2 proteins, and high solids content

possible_diseases.name: Hemorrhagic Septicemia (HS)
possible_diseases.symptoms: High fever, swollen throat, labored breathing, salivation
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Post-monsoon season, seasonal river bed grazing

possible_diseases.name: Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Ulcers in dental pad, tongue, interdigital clefts, lameness

possible_diseases.name: Mastitis
possible_diseases.symptoms: Quarter swelling, watery milk, reduction in yield

possible_diseases.name: External Parasites (Lice & Ticks)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Skin rubbing, hair loss, restlessness, tick-borne anemia

possible_diseases.name: Internal Helminthiasis (Flukes & Roundworms)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Diarrhea, pot-bellied appearance in calves, submandibular bottle jaw

cure_and_treatment.emergency_first_aid: For HS: Prompt veterinary administration of Sulfadimidine sodium (33.3% IV) + Oxytetracycline. For severe bloat: Administer oral oil with carminatives.
veterinary_medicines: Ivermectin (1 ml / 50 kg SC) for external ticks/lice and internal roundworms
Triclabendazole / Oxyclozanide for liver fluke in tank-grazing buffaloes
Intramammary antibiotics for mastitis
Meloxicam boluses for pain and inflammatory conditions
cure_and_treatment.supportive_care: Regular mineral mixture supplementation containing zinc, phosphorus, and sulfur; multi-vitamin drench.
cure_and_treatment.ethnoveterinary_remedies: For ectoparasites/ticks: Spray paste of Annona squamosa (sitaphal) leaves + neem seed extract (5%) mixed in water.

market_price.economic_roi: Ideal for low-input dryland farming systems; high survival rate in drought conditions ensures steady family income.

daily_feed_requirements.dry_fodder_kg: 6 - 8 kg/day (Jowar kadbi, Soybean straw, Cottonseed hull)
daily_feed_requirements.concentrate_feed_kg: 1 kg per 2.0 liters milk + 1.5 kg maintenance (Cottonseed cake, Gram chuni, wheat bran)

maintenance_and_housing.housing_and_shed_design: Low-cost semi-open housing with thatched or asbestos roof with good ventilation. 40-50 sq.ft covered stall area.
maintenance_and_housing.summer_heat_management: Wallowing in village ponds or spraying with water twice daily; paint roofs white in summer.
maintenance_and_housing.milking_hygiene_protocol: Full hand milking, teat washing, clean bucket usage, calf suckling for letdown.

red_sindhi.name: Red Sindhi Cattle
red_sindhi.native_region: Pan-India dairy herds, tropical and coastal belts
red_sindhi.description: Red Sindhi is a premier indigenous tropical dairy cattle breed closely related to Sahiwal. Recognized for its deep solid mahogany red coat, compact frame, outstanding heat and humidity tolerance, high fertility, low feed requirement, and rich milk yield under tropical heat.

physical_traits.coat_color: Deep mahogany red, varying from dark red to yellowish brown
physical_traits.horns: Short, thick, emerging laterally and curving upwards
physical_traits.body_structure: Compact dairy wedge, fine bone structure, well-developed hump and dewlap, well-shaped capacious udder
physical_traits.climate_resilience: Outstanding resistance to tropical heat, humidity, solar radiation, and tick infestation

milk_quality.suitability: Ideal for drinking milk, cultured buttermilk (chaas), butter, and paneer
milk_quality.somatic_cell_count: Consistently low due to tight teat sphincter conformation
milk_quality.nutritional_highlights: Rich in bioavailable calcium, riboflavin, and protective enzymes

possible_diseases.name: Mastitis
possible_diseases.symptoms: Hardness in quarter, yellowish flakes in milk, mild fever

possible_diseases.name: Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Blisters on tongue and hooves, salivation, loss of appetite

possible_diseases.name: Hemorrhagic Septicemia (HS)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Sudden fever, swollen throat, labored breathing

possible_diseases.name: Tick-Borne Diseases
possible_diseases.symptoms: Mild fever, tick attachment (Red Sindhi has strong natural resistance)

cure_and_treatment.emergency_first_aid: For acute mastitis: Strip milk every 2 hours, apply herbal mastitis paste (turmeric + aloe vera). For bloat: Oral drench of 100ml ginger-asafetida oil mix.
veterinary_medicines: Intramammary Ceftiofur / Cloxacillin for mastitis
Oxytetracycline / Enrofloxacin for bacterial infections
Meloxicam for anti-inflammatory relief
Albendazole / Ivermectin for routine deworming
cure_and_treatment.supportive_care: Chelated mineral mixture, probiotic rumen yeast, vitamin A, D3, E injections.
cure_and_treatment.ethnoveterinary_remedies: For digestive support: Boil 20g cumin + 20g ajwain + 50g jaggery in water and drench warm.

market_price.economic_roi: High profitability in hot/humid tropical zones due to low feed intake, low veterinary maintenance, and premium A2 milk prices.

daily_feed_requirements.concentrate_feed_kg: 1 kg per 2.5 L milk + 1.5 kg maintenance (Mustard cake, wheat bran, chana chuni)

maintenance_and_housing.housing_and_shed_design: Semi-open shed with 35-45 sq.ft covered stall. Good cross-ventilation, brick-on-edge or grooved concrete floor.
maintenance_and_housing.summer_heat_management: Handles extreme heat with ease; provide clean cool drinking water and shaded resting area.
maintenance_and_housing.milking_hygiene_protocol: Gentle full hand milking, pre- and post-milking teat sanitization.

sahiwal.name: Sahiwal Cattle
sahiwal.native_region: Northern & Central India (Punjab, Haryana, UP, Rajasthan, MP)
sahiwal.description: Sahiwal is regarded as the best indigenous milch cattle breed of the Indian subcontinent. Characterized by its reddish-dun coat, loose skin (giving rise to the local name Lola), heavy dewlap, placid disposition, superior dairy temperament, and high milk yield with 4.5 - 5.5% butterfat and 100% A2 beta-casein.

physical_traits.coat_color: Reddish brown to pale red or light dun with occasional white patches on underline
physical_traits.body_structure: Deep, heavy, symmetrical dairy conformation, loose skin folds, massive pendulous dewlap and navel flap, well-suspended square udder
physical_traits.temperament: Extremely docile, calm, and friendly with milkers
physical_traits.climate_resilience: Highest heat tolerance among dairy cattle; completely immune to intense summer heat waves and tick fevers

milk_quality.suitability: Premier milk for drinking, artisanal A2 Ghee, thick curd, paneer, and khoya sweets
milk_quality.somatic_cell_count: Very low somatic cell count; high mastitis resistance
milk_quality.nutritional_highlights: Rich in CLA, beta-carotene, micronutrients, and easily digestible A2 proteins

possible_diseases.name: Mastitis
possible_diseases.symptoms: Quarter warmth, swelling, abnormal milk clots

possible_diseases.name: Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Oral blisters, drooling saliva, lameness, milk drop

possible_diseases.name: Hemorrhagic Septicemia (HS)
possible_diseases.symptoms: High fever (106°F), throat edema, difficult breathing

possible_diseases.name: Milk Fever (Hypocalcemia)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Post-calving recumbency, cold ears, inability to rise
possible_diseases.risk_factors: High calcium drain at peak freshening in elite high yielders

cure_and_treatment.emergency_first_aid: For milk fever: Administer 450ml IV Calcium Borogluconate slowly under veterinary supervision. For mastitis: Strip quarter completely and apply ice compresses.
veterinary_medicines: Intramammary Cefquinome / Cloxacillin for mastitis
Sulfadimidine sodium (33.3% IV) / Ceftriaxone for systemic infections
Meloxicam + Flunixin Meglumine for pain and fever
Fenbendazole / Ivermectin for routine deworming
cure_and_treatment.supportive_care: Chelated mineral mixture, Vitamin H (Biotin), DCAD balancing in pre-calving diet.
cure_and_treatment.ethnoveterinary_remedies: For udder health: Aloe vera (250g) + Turmeric (50g) + Lime (15g) paste applied externally 3 times daily after milking.

market_price.economic_roi: Highest commercial profitability among indigenous Indian cattle; unmatched combination of high milk volume, high butterfat (5%), and premium A2 pricing.

daily_feed_requirements.concentrate_feed_kg: 1 kg per 2.5 L milk + 2.0 kg maintenance (Cottonseed cake, Mustard cake, crushed maize, wheat bran)

maintenance_and_housing.housing_and_shed_design: Spacious loose housing shed with 50-60 sq.ft covered space, 100 sq.ft open loafing area, high roof (12-14 ft), grooved non-slip flooring.
maintenance_and_housing.summer_heat_management: Superb heat tolerance; provide ceiling fans and fresh drinking water in summer.
maintenance_and_housing.milking_hygiene_protocol: Full hand milking, pre- and post-milking teat dip, regular strip cup testing.

surti.name: Surti Buffalo
surti.native_region: Gujarat & Western India (Anand, Kheda, Vadodara, Surat, Bharuch)
surti.description: Surti is a medium-sized, economical dairy buffalo breed originating from the fertile Charotar tract of Gujarat (the cradle of India's White Revolution / Amul). Recognised for its unique sickle-shaped flat horns, two white collars ('chevron') on the throat and brisket, high butterfat content (8-9%), and gentle temperament.

physical_traits.coat_color: Rusty brown to silver-grey or black; distinct white chevron collars on lower jaw/throat and brisket
physical_traits.horns: Sickle-shaped, flat, curving downward and backward and then turning upwards at tips
physical_traits.body_structure: Medium, well-proportioned wedge-shaped body, straight back, clean-cut head, well-developed square udder with pinkish skin
physical_traits.temperament: Very gentle, calm, and cooperative with farm women and milkers
physical_traits.climate_resilience: High tolerance to coastal and irrigated agricultural climates; excellent feed conversion

milk_quality.fat_globule_size: Large butterfat globules with rich creamy texture
milk_quality.suitability: Premier milk for Amul-grade butter, traditional white ghee, paneer, and rich shrikhand
milk_quality.somatic_cell_count: Consistently low; highly resistant to udder infections
milk_quality.nutritional_highlights: High protein-to-calorie ratio, rich in bioavailable calcium and natural immunoglobulins

possible_diseases.name: Mastitis
possible_diseases.symptoms: Hardness in udder, warmth, clotting in milk

possible_diseases.name: Hemorrhagic Septicemia (HS)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Severe fever, neck swelling, labored breathing, salivation

possible_diseases.name: Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Oral vesicles, foot sores, drooling, drastic milk loss

possible_diseases.name: Anestrus & Repeat Breeding
possible_diseases.symptoms: Silent heat, prolonged non-cycling during summer months
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Seasonal summer thermal stress, mineral deficiency (phosphorus/zinc)

possible_diseases.name: Trypanosomiasis (Surra)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Recurrent fever, emaciation, eye discharge
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Biting fly season near irrigation canals

cure_and_treatment.emergency_first_aid: For HS: Emergency Sulfadimidine (33.3% IV) + Flunixin Meglumine. For summer silent heat: Administer oral mineral mixtures + PMSG/GnRH hormone protocol under veterinarian.
veterinary_medicines: Intramammary Ceftiofur / Cloxacillin for mastitis
Quinapyramine prosalt for Surra prophylaxis and treatment
GnRH (Buserelin Acetate 2.5 ml IM) + PGF2alpha for estrus synchronization
Broad-spectrum dewormers (Fenbendazole / Ivermectin)
cure_and_treatment.supportive_care: Provide Chelated Mineral Mixture (Minfa Gold), Vitamin A, D3, E (Intavita) injections.
cure_and_treatment.ethnoveterinary_remedies: For silent heat / estrus induction: Feed sprouted wheat (1 kg/day for 15 days) + aloe vera pulp (150g) + jaggery.

market_price.economic_roi: One of the most cost-effective buffalo breeds in India; economical feed intake with high fat milk yields steady monthly dairy cooperative payouts.

daily_feed_requirements.concentrate_feed_kg: 1 kg per 2.0 liters of milk + 1.5 kg maintenance (Cottonseed cake, maize bran, pulse chuni)

maintenance_and_housing.housing_and_shed_design: Semi-covered shed with 40-50 sq.ft covered area. Good ventilation, grooved non-slip flooring with drainage channels.
maintenance_and_housing.summer_heat_management: Provide afternoon wallowing in clean pond or spray cold water over buffalo body twice daily in summer.
maintenance_and_housing.milking_hygiene_protocol: Full hand milking method, teat sanitization before and after milking.

toda.name: Toda Buffalo
toda.origin: Nilgiri Hills, Western Ghats, Tamil Nadu
toda.native_region: Nilgiri Plateau (Ooty, Coonoor, Kotagiri at 1,800 - 2,500m elevation in Tamil Nadu)
toda.description: Toda buffalo is an ancient, distinct, semi-wild highland buffalo breed endemic to the Nilgiri Hills of the Western Ghats. Reared exclusively by the indigenous Toda pastoralist tribe as sacred animals, they are characterized by their striking crescent-shaped horns, dense ash-grey fawn coat, and extraordinary adaptation to cold, high-altitude rainforests and steep mountainous terrain.

physical_traits.coat_color: Fawn to ash-grey with dense thick hair coat (rare among buffaloes); distinct dark chevron marking across throat and chest
physical_traits.horns: Long, massive, crescent-shaped horns curving wide sideways, backwards, and outwards with sharp inward-pointing tips
physical_traits.body_structure: Stout, low-set muscular body, broad chest, strong shoulders, hard climbing hooves designed for rocky mountain slopes
physical_traits.temperament: Semi-feral, alert, fiercely independent; docile only towards indigenous Toda handlers
physical_traits.climate_resilience: Superb tolerance to cold, freezing mountain mist, high rainfall (>2,500mm), and steep mountain slopes

milk_quality.suitability: Sacred ceremonial ghee, rich mountain butter, traditional fermented curd, and high-fat paneer
milk_quality.somatic_cell_count: Virtually zero incidence of clinical mastitis in natural shola grazing
milk_quality.nutritional_highlights: High concentration of medicinal pasture phytonutrients, antioxidants, and conjugated linoleic acids from wild shola herbs

possible_diseases.name: Fascioliasis (Liver Fluke Disease)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Submandibular edema (bottle jaw), progressive weight loss, diarrhea, anemia
possible_diseases.risk_factors: Grazing near high-altitude mountain bogs and water streams harboring Lymnaea snails

possible_diseases.name: Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Blisters on muzzle and interdigital space, high fever, severe lameness on steep slopes

possible_diseases.name: Hemorrhagic Septicemia (HS)
possible_diseases.symptoms: High fever, throat swelling, acute respiratory distress

possible_diseases.name: External Leeches & Ticks
possible_diseases.symptoms: Blood loss, nasal leech infestation causing epistaxis (nose bleeding)

possible_diseases.name: Black Quarter (BQ)
possible_diseases.symptoms: Crackling muscle swelling, severe lameness, fever

cure_and_treatment.emergency_first_aid: For nasal leeches: Irrigate nasal passage with 10% saline solution or tobacco decoction to dislodge leeches. For acute fluke anemia: Administer oral Triclabendazole.
veterinary_medicines: Triclabendazole (12 mg/kg) / Oxyclozanide for liver fluke eradication
Ivermectin injection (1 ml/50 kg SC) for ticks and internal parasites
Sulfadimidine sodium / Ceftriaxone for respiratory infections
Meloxicam injections for joint and muscular pain
cure_and_treatment.supportive_care: Iron tonic (Feritas/Imferon) for recovery from fluke anemia, Himalayan rock salt licks.
cure_and_treatment.ethnoveterinary_remedies: Traditional Toda herbal remedies: Decoction of Nilgiri eucalyptus leaves, wild turmeric, and neem oil applied to wounds.

vaccination_schedule.importance: Critical to protect endangered indigenous gene pool

market_price.economic_roi: Low maintenance costs; thrives on free shola grazing with zero grain costs; exceptional specialty ghee quality with organic niche appeal.

daily_feed_requirements.green_fodder_kg: 25 - 35 kg/day (Natural grazing on Shola grasslands, Kikuyu grass, Hill bamboo, Mountain clover)
daily_feed_requirements.concentrate_feed_kg: 0.5 - 1.5 kg/day (Concentrate supplement for lactating buffaloes: Rice bran, Groundnut cake)

maintenance_and_housing.housing_and_shed_design: Traditional Toda stone wall enclosure ('Tu') or simple well-drained mountain shed with wooden posts and thatch/tin roof to protect from heavy rain and wind.
maintenance_and_housing.summer_heat_management: Natural cool mountain climate (temperature rarely exceeds 25°C); protect from monsoon dampness with dry bedding.
maintenance_and_housing.milking_hygiene_protocol: Traditional peaceful milking, gentle udder washing with spring water, warm soothing touch.
